title: Published post front matter
description: The YAML front matter of a post at published/posts/<slug>.md (Reflect framework plan, step 6). Each value is written as JSON, which YAML reads as it is. The body after the front matter is the work's Markdown. Only an essay, letter, plan or memoir is ever published; a journal entry never is. packages/core/src/published.ts writes and checks it.
